🎥🎬: Transformers (2007)

Teenager Sam Witwicky unknowingly becomes caught in an ancient war between two factions of alien robots: the heroic Autobots and the ruthless Decepticons. When Sam discovers that his new car, Bumblebee, is actually a living robot, his ordinary life suddenly turns into a fight for the fate of Earth.

The Autobots arrive on Earth searching for the AllSpark, a powerful artifact capable of creating life, while the Decepticons want to use it to conquer the planet. As the two sides clash, Sam and the Autobots must protect the AllSpark before it falls into the wrong hands.

source_details.synopsis: Transformers is a 2007 American science fiction action film based on Hasbro's toy line of the same name. Directed by Michael Bay from a screenplay by Roberto Orci and Alex Kurtzman, it is the first installment of the Transformers film series. The film stars Shia LaBeouf as Sam Witwicky, a teenager who gets caught up in a war between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons, two factions of shape-shifting alien robots. The Autobots and Decepticons both seek a powerful artifact called the AllSpark, to win the war that has devastated their home planet of Cybertron.
